notes: Round-89 mutant set: M01-M22 carried byte-equal from .ufo/waves/round-88/controls/mako-mutants-r88.json; M23-M37 target the summary~/body~ POSIX ERE matcher (libc regcomp/regexec, C locale), the criteria tokenizer's backslash-inside-quotes and space-only token rules, the cannot-set-both refusal, REG_NEWLINE, end-of-input escapes and every regex occurrence being compiled. M33-M37 were added from the w1 review (R89MReviewC1 F1/M33, R89MMutTester N04/N07/N14) before the freeze. Each old anchor must occur exactly once in the candidate tool.

mutants.description: criteria options only fill unset keys, so they never override defaults or the global section (breaks last-wins and any matching override; L435-437)
the global section is dropped; resolution sees defaults and criteria only (L519-522)
a relative include path is accepted and read from the working directory instead of being refused (L45-48)
~/ include paths expand to the filesystem root instead of --home (L16-17, L48)
the initial mode list is empty, so [mode=default] sections never apply (L620-621)
effective starts empty instead of from the manual defaults (L519-522)
app-name criteria are never compared, so sections for other applications apply (L443-444)
a criteria app-name with no --app-name supplied is treated as a match instead of refused
urgency criteria match when the notification urgency differs (L459)
an unterminated quote in a criteria header is not refused and yields an unconditional match (L497-508)
an exact string criteria field (app-icon, summary, body, category, desktop-entry) never mismatches, so a section for another value applies (L445-463)
an exact string criteria field whose notification input was not supplied is treated as a match instead of refused
a bare !actionable / !expiring token means true instead of false (L516)
boolean words are compared case-sensitively, so TRUE/False are refused (types.c parse_boolean uses strcasecmp)
actionable/expiring criteria match when the notification flag differs (L465-467)
a boolean criteria field whose notification flag was not supplied is treated as a match instead of refused
a boolean criteria value outside true/false/1/0 (e.g. yes) is not refused (L510-516)

a regex match counts as a mismatch and a non-match as a match
